integrity.description: The agent actually analyzed the file rather than guessing or using pre-existing knowledge.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent interacting with Wireshark, tshark, or tcpdump; the report should not appear instantly without file interaction.

integrity.description: The agent extracted the 'verified_value' from the pcap, not the 'metadata_value' (which contains placeholders).
integrity.visual_evidence: The report must show username 'fake' and password 'user', not 'ga' or 'password123'.

integrity.description: The agent lists only the commands actually present in the pcap stream.
